relationships.subject: Capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsaicin, TRPV1 modulator, is the only agent successfully examined in clinical trials with promising effects in patients with DNP.

relationships.subject: CaMKII
relationships.evidence_quote: Current data suggest that blocking calcium calmodulin dependent protein kinase II (CaMKII) is superior to other approaches, considering its pivotal role in regulating the pain neuron potentials.

key_findings: Review: protein kinases regulate TRPV1 and P2X7R, whose blockade is analgesic in DNP models.
CaMKII inhibition is proposed as the preferred approach to relieve DNP.
